instructions_for_codex: Use the configured prices and limits as the approved product defaults. Keep live billing activation disabled until provider credentials and staging checkout/webhook verification are complete.
Implement a modular per-project pricing engine. Do not gate unrelated business functionality behind higher foundation tiers.
Use integer minor currency units for monetary calculations (INR paise, USD cents), never floating-point money.
Store price versions, subscription item references, entitlements, usage meters and wallet ledgers. Never trust client-side balances or billing amounts.
Present pricing by resolved billing region; do not dynamically convert using exchange rates.
Show base subscription and optional add-ons separately, with transparent usage allowances and tax-exclusive totals.
A completed AI SEO bundled job must not also debit general AI credits unless its bundled job allowance is exhausted and the user approves the extra charge.
Implement project/team RBAC and per-member AI spending limits.
Keep this JSON as a design/configuration reference; adapt to existing schema and payments integration before coding.

india.taxes: GST if applicable; computed separately at checkout

international.taxes: Applicable local taxes computed separately at checkout

region_resolution.before_checkout: Cloudflare CF-IPCountry geo-IP for indicative display; use INR for IN and USD for all other or unknown countries
region_resolution.price_lock: persist currency and price version for the purchased subscription
region_resolution.anti_abuse: Do not grant India pricing solely because the UI currency selector was changed

billing.yearly_billing: charge yearly price upfront; monthlyEquivalent is display-only
billing.transaction_fee_note: Zero Velozy platform transaction commission; payment gateway fees, taxes, third-party messaging and other approved variable costs are separate
billing.subscription_scope: one published project/website per foundation subscription
billing.free_plan_policy: One draft homepage may be generated and previewed; publishing and additional pages require a paid foundation subscription.
billing.proration: prorate add-on activations/upgrades; schedule downgrades/removals at renewal; use payment-provider capabilities
billing.monthly_allowance_reset: every subscription month, including during an annual subscription

fields.monthly: amount charged for each monthly billing cycle
fields.annual_total: amount charged upfront for a year

price_format.charm_pricing: INR price points end in 9; USD prices end in .99; annual total reflects exactly twelve displayed annual-month equivalents

optional_modules.name: Customer Subscriptions
optional_modules.note: Independent of physical-goods commerce; requires supported payment provider

optional_modules.name: Marketing Automation
optional_modules.cost_rules: AI message generation uses AI credits unless separately bundled; sending charges consume communication allowances; require user consent, opt-in, and per-channel compliance

commerce_policy.mutual_exclusion: exactly zero or one commerce package per project
commerce_policy.order_limits: soft; never abruptly disable active checkout solely because the monthly order allowance was exceeded
commerce_policy.overage_handling: notify at 80%, 100% and 120%, apply grace policy, offer capacity packs or package upgrade; no automatic charge without approval
commerce_policy.grace_policy_suggestion: allow temporary excess while coordinating upgrade; rate-limit abuse/fraud separately

seo_policy.mutual_exclusion: exactly zero or one SEO package per project; autopilot replaces growth, never stacks
seo_policy.data_integrity: No invented keyword volumes, search rankings, traffic estimates, or competitor facts. Clearly distinguish provider estimates from first-party GSC observations.
seo_policy.content_safety: No copying competitor prose; verify merchant offerings and material claims; user approval for initial strategy and sensitive content; avoid scaled low-value SEO spam
seo_policy.bundled_job_rule: included articles and landing pages do not subtract general AI credits; optional images, premium generation modes and extra jobs require explicitly previewed credits
seo_policy.limits_policy: research jobs pause on exhaustion; existing published content and stored reports remain accessible

credit_system.subscription_credits: refill monthly; unused included credits expire at cycle boundary
credit_system.purchased_credits: carry forward while project remains active, subject to disclosed legal and contract terms

credit_unit_economics_hypothesis.warning: illustrative only, benchmark every provider/model before charging

credit_system.failed_jobs: release reservations and refund all unsuccessful work unless a separately disclosed partial-charge policy applies
credit_system.member_budgets: admins can set per-member monthly budgets and require approvals for expensive jobs
credit_system.overage: no negative balances or surprise charges

capacity_topups.research_units: price after verifying provider costs; do not launch with placeholder charge
capacity_topups.storage_and_bandwidth: separate capacity packs to be priced after hosting/CDN cost measurement
capacity_topups.communication: charge actual approved channel/provider rates or published pre-paid packs; comply with messaging consent laws

collaboration.billing_permission: owner or explicitly delegated billing admins
collaboration.agency_mode_future: workspace for many independently billed projects; optional central invoicing

entitlement_rules.downgrade_policy: retain customer records/content and remove premium creation/access after disclosed grace period; do not delete data automatically
entitlement_rules.cancelled_module_policy: preserve records and relevant existing data; stop future premium actions at effective end date
entitlement_rules.orders_over_limit_policy: soft limit and proactive upgrade flow, never unannounced checkout shutdown
entitlement_rules.expired_ai_credits_policy: live site and manual editing continue to function

product_messages: Choose only what your business needs
No mandatory SEO upgrade to run a store
AI credits are shared per project
Never disable your published website when AI credits are exhausted
checkout_ux.promotions: future promo codes should be separate discount rules, not changes to versioned list prices
checkout_ux.renewal_disclosure: show upfront annual charge, renewal charge and any discounted first-period pricing distinctly
checkout_ux.preview: show action-specific AI credit costs and upcoming quota usage before generating

launch_validation.target_variable_gross_margin: at least 70% as initial planning goal, adjust by module and cohort
